mapper.sql: b.board_id, b.user_id, u.nickname AS user_nickname, b.trip_plan_id, tp.title AS trip_plan_title, b.title, b.content, b.board_type, b.view_count, b.created_at, b.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM boards b LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = b.user_id LEFT JOIN trip_plans tp ON tp.trip_plan_id = b.trip_plan_id WHERE b.board_id = #{boardId}

SELECT c.comment_id, c.board_id, c.user_id, u.nickname AS user_nickname, c.content, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM board_comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = c.user_id WHERE c.board_id = #{boardId} ORDER BY c.comment_id
SELECT image_id, board_id, image_url, original_name, saved_name, created_at FROM board_images WHERE board_id = #{boardId} ORDER BY image_id
